$comment: §323 fieldmap SCHEMA v2 for the ERPSystem hop (OUTBOUND: CEH/Company Manager is the source; e-conomic mirrors customers + contacts). The payload contract is the operator's PROVEN legacy automation (tools/legacy-automation webhook-customer / webhook-contact), now implemented live in LiveEconomicErpClient. ORDER→INVOICE is deliberately NOT a CEH write: the legacy Azure Function webhook-syncorders owns it (documented in the Order record below as owned-by-legacy-webhook).

source.notes: Customer facts originate in Company Manager (WordPress) and are mirrored by CEH; the resolved PUBLIC company name chain is public → legal → billing → 'Company {id}'.

target.notes: Auth: X-AppSecretToken + X-AgreementGrantToken headers (Key-Vault-backed app settings). Paged GETs follow pagination.nextPage.

limitations: DEDUPE BY NAME (legacy rule): full paged list, trimmed case-insensitive match — never create a same-named customer twice
hub-side idempotency: ErpCustomerLink (one per event+company); CVR modulus-11 gate blocks the FIRST create only
PUT replaces the record — read-merge-write (fetch, overlay hub-owned fields, PUT back)

fields.limitations: ALWAYS the resolved public name chain — never the legal/billing name as primary
Danish CVR (8-digit modulus-11) validated before the first create (hard block); re-syncs proceed
falls back to the agreement base currency (DKK) when the company carries none

limitations: DEDUPE BY E-MAIL under the customer (case-insensitive) — an existing contact is left alone (edits stay with the §26g reconcile)
roles ride the notes field: Role:1 = signer (default_signer_id), Role:2 = event coordinator (event_coordination_default_contact_id)

fields.limitations: 'Role:1' / 'Role:2' convention — parsed by the §26g role-audience readers

limitations: OWNED BY THE LEGACY WEBHOOK (webhook-syncorders, DESIGN §18.2) — CEH must NOT create these (double-invoice risk); LiveEconomicErpClient.CreateOrderAsync deliberately throws
idempotency: references.other = 'WebshopOrderId-{orderNumber}' checked across drafts + booked
webshop prices are EUR; converted to the customer currency via the currency API (ceiling)
line product by VAT zone: 1 → product 1000 (Indland-Tax), 2/3/4 → product 2000 (No-Tax); layout 'English*'; notes.heading '{EventName} - {CommunityName}', textLine1 'Sponsorship'
